reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000781 (the melody read from 000781a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. William Batchelder Bradbury's dates (1816–1868) are from our page for the tune BRADBURY (content/hymns/tunes/bradbury.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1843. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000781a.nwc). The tune ends on F#, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
